responsibility: Supplies the declarative extension-definition table for MIPS vendor extensions within the RISC-V port’s centralized extension registry. Its `DEFINE_RISCV_EXT` entries describe extensions such as `xmipscmov` and `xmipscbop`, including canonical names, human-readable titles, supported version tuples, flag-group membership, and placeholder feature-bit allocation fields, so shared generators and option/documentation machinery can expose these MIPS-specific subextensions consistently alongside other vendor extensions.
